race.comment: DUSTY BAY (3) comes here with a fitness edge over his main rivals and gets the services of J Mac from the good draw. On the quick backup with a tough on pace second to Avista over 1400m at this track. No excuses today. BARRENGARRY (5) exciting gelding resuming with the one trial placing over 920m. Just under a month between runs with a tiring fifth over 2000m in the G3 Frank Packer Plate here last April. Comes to hand quickly and expected to go on with it this campaign. FELIX MAJESTIC (1) tough on pace gelding who will appreciate the class drop. Collared late from the wide gate with a narrow third over 1400m at Rosehill in BM78 grade. Will take control early and give plenty of cheek. LONG LEGS (4) found the 1200m too short first up and gets the blinkers added today. Minor claims. The chances don't end there.
